before:
Keep your shoulder blades
pulled together on the bench.
after:
Keep your shoulder blades
back against the bench.

before:
Test with the empty bar.
Align it with your upper chest.
after:
Set the bench so the bar
lowers to your upper chest.

before:
Secure your feet. Lower the
bar without bouncing.
after:
Hook your feet under the pads.
Don't bounce the bar.

before:
Keep the dumbbells apart
at the top of each rep.
after:
Don't bang the dumbbells
together at the top.

before:
Keep your back on the pad
as you bring your arms together.
after:
Keep your back on the pad
throughout each rep.

before:
Keep a slight elbow bend.
Keep your torso still.
after:
Bend your elbows slightly.
Keep your torso still.
